metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins that ship quality. sniff walks your running app in a real browser and tells you what is actually broken, with the steps to reproduce it. ui-ux-suite is ESLint for design: the exact line, the measured wrong value, the exact fix. recap-studio turns a topic or a coding session into one offline HTML explainer you can double-click. aws-cost-audit reads your live AWS account read-only and checks every price against live AWS pricing. goalify writes the brief and the condition for a big task a fresh session runs on its own. humanizer names 55 AI writing habits and rewrites text in the voice you pick. loopify writes the brief and the line that keep a repeating job running on Claude Code's built-in /loop. The tool plugins are dual-mode (a Claude Code plugin or a standalone MCP server); aws-cost-audit, goalify, humanizer and loopify are Claude Code skills (no MCP server).

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: Point it at your running app. It walks your real user flows in a real browser and tells you what is actually broken, with proof: the route, the ordered steps, and the screenshot or console excerpt behind every finding. A source scan is also available via `sniff scan`. No API key.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: ESLint for design. It reads your CSS, JSX, HTML and Tailwind classes, then names the exact line, the measured wrong value, and the exact fix, with the WCAG criterion or named UX law behind it. Scores 12 dimensions. It audits, it never edits. Zero dependencies.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Turn any topic or coding session into a dark-mode, mobile-first explainer you can double-click to open. The output is one HTML file with every style inlined, no JavaScript and no external request, readable offline in about five minutes. Deterministic checks score it before you ship.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Ask Claude to audit your AWS bill. It reads your live account through the AWS CLI you already have, attributes every dollar, finds the idle and over-provisioned resources, and hands you a savings plan where every number is checked against live AWS pricing. Read-only by default. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Hand Claude a huge task. Come back to proof it's done, not a promise that it is. goalify writes the brief (a file holding what the run has to do) and the condition (one line you paste into `/goal`), so a fresh session does the job and quotes the checks passing in its closing turn. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: AI writing has a fingerprint. humanizer knows 55 of those habits, names the ones it finds in your text, scores the text 0 to 100 from measurable signals, and rewrites it in the voice you pick, restoring the sentence-length variation people write with. Pure Markdown, zero dependencies, nothing leaves your machine. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: loopify
plugins.description: Hand Claude a job that repeats. Come back to a log of what every tick did, not a loop you have to babysit. loopify writes the brief (a standing file the loop re-reads every tick) and the line (one string you paste into Claude Code's built-in `/loop`), with a tick cap, a stop rule and five safety rails. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).
